column1: # Russian pack lexicon (FR-13): word<TAB>reading. Applied before normalization; user and
# per-book lexicons override it. Stress: "+" before the vowel.
# Latin-script terms whose usual Russian reading is not their English sound (FR-24);
# other Latin words are transliterated from English pronunciation.
# Stress and ё the G2P model misses (M3 step 8b). Exact word forms, with е and ё spellings.
# RUAccent reads these as «нёбо»; the palate spelled with ё is untouched.
